summary: Tighten the repo-local developer loop around the current `desktop + src-ts` authority path by adding shared JS/TS lint-format entrypoints, then removing the stale `pytest.ini` legacy coverage default and realigning `scripts/delivery_gate.py` only where it must observe the new local baseline.

tasks.title: Add shared JS/TS quality config and package-level local baseline commands
tasks.description: Create 2-3 repo-level quality config files for the current TypeScript product surface, add `lint`, `format`, `format:check`, and one local baseline command to both `desktop` and `src-ts`, and update the 2 package lockfiles so the baseline is reproducible from a clean checkout without adding a new root package manager surface.
tasks.scope: Update 2 package manifests (`desktop/package.json`, `src-ts/package.json`), refresh 2 lockfiles, and add 2-3 repo-level quality config files such as `eslint.config.*`, `prettier.config.*`, and ignore rules scoped to `desktop` and `src-ts`.

criteria: 2 package manifests expose `lint`, `format`, `format:check`, and `check:local` or an equivalently named authoritative local-baseline command.
2-3 repo-level quality config files exist and target only the active `desktop` and `src-ts` source/config surfaces while excluding build output, generated artifacts, and workflow directories.
The new local baseline keeps `desktop` sidecar validation and `src-ts` phase-4 tests in the developer loop instead of relying on CI-only quality enforcement.
convergence.verification: Run `npm --prefix src-ts run lint && npm --prefix src-ts run format:check && npm --prefix src-ts run check:local && npm --prefix desktop run lint && npm --prefix desktop run format:check && npm --prefix desktop run check:local`.
convergence.definition_of_done: Both active product packages share one repo-level lint/format baseline and expose a reproducible local validation command that a later execution workflow can call directly.

implementation.title: Define shared repo-level quality config
implementation.description: Add the minimal shared lint/format config files and ignore rules required to cover `desktop` and `src-ts` without sweeping historical or generated surfaces into the first baseline pass.

implementation.title: Wire package scripts and dependencies
implementation.description: Add the baseline scripts and matching tool dependencies to `desktop/package.json` and `src-ts/package.json`, then refresh the 2 lockfiles so the commands are runnable on a clean checkout.

implementation.title: Promote one authoritative local baseline per package
implementation.description: Make the new package commands the clear developer-loop entrypoints by composing lint, format check, existing validation, typecheck, and the current high-signal test/build steps already relevant to `desktop + src-ts`.

tasks.title: Retire legacy pytest defaults and align delivery gate anchors with the local baseline
tasks.description: Remove the stale `pytest.ini` default coverage posture bound to `src`, preserve a targeted Python regression path for remaining script tests, and update `scripts/delivery_gate.py` only where its baseline anchors must follow the new package-level local validation commands from B1 rather than the older assumptions.
tasks.scope: Update 2 legacy baseline files (`pytest.ini`, `scripts/delivery_gate.py`) so Python test defaults stop asserting coverage over the retired `src` authority path and the delivery gate observes the new local developer-loop anchors without expanding governance scope.

criteria: `pytest.ini` no longer defaults to `--cov=src` or `--cov-fail-under=100`, and the default pytest invocation remains valid for the residual script-test surface.
`scripts/delivery_gate.py` checks the new local baseline anchors introduced in B1 only where those anchors replace the previous package-script assumptions.

The task does not modify `.github` workflows, `scripts/check_authority_alignment.py`, or `scripts/release_check_summary.py`; it only keeps the local semantic gate consistent with the updated developer baseline.
convergence.verification: Run `python -m pytest tests/unit/scripts/test_governance_scripts.py -q && python scripts/delivery_gate.py` after the B1 package-script changes are in place.
convergence.definition_of_done: Legacy Python defaults no longer point at the removed `src` coverage target, and the delivery gate reflects the new local baseline without reopening completed governance hardening.

implementation.title: Reset pytest defaults to the surviving Python surface
implementation.description: Trim `pytest.ini` so the default addopts no longer encode obsolete `src` coverage assumptions while keeping markers and developer-friendly output for the remaining script tests.

implementation.title: Map delivery-gate anchors to the new package baseline
implementation.description: Review the existing `desktop/package.json` and `src-ts/package.json` anchors in `scripts/delivery_gate.py` and update only the checks that must follow the new local baseline commands introduced by B1.

implementation.title: Confirm non-governance scope remains unchanged
implementation.description: Verify the semantic gate still limits itself to local baseline consistency and does not add fresh authority-alignment or CI-hardening requirements already closed by the 2026-04-07 governance session.

risks: A repo-wide lint rollout can explode into noisy edits if implementation does not restrict the first pass to the current `desktop` and `src-ts` authority surfaces plus explicit ignore rules.

Changing the meaning of `desktop` or `src-ts` check scripts can break existing operator habits; implementation should prefer a new authoritative local-baseline alias over silently widening an old script in place.

Some residual Python test tooling may still assume the current `pytest.ini` addopts; removing `--cov=src` must preserve the targeted governance-script regression path instead of disabling Python checks entirely.
out_of_scope: Refactoring `desktop/src/api/client.ts`, `desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs`, or `src-ts/container/*` as part of this baseline module.
A full repo-wide Python lint/format adoption pass across every legacy script or archived surface.
